description: This file contains utility functions for accounting-related operations within the OFBiz framework, including methods for retrieving account IDs, checking account and invoice types, and computing exchange rates. It defines a final utility class UtilAccounting with static methods, references external entity models, and throws custom exceptions.

classes.name: UtilAccounting
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for accounting operations in OFBiz, including account retrieval, type checks, and exchange rate calculations.

methods.name: getProductOrgGlAccountId
methods.description: Fetches the GL account ID for a product or its default account if product-specific account is not found, based on organization and account type.

methods.name: getDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the default account ID for a given account type and organization.

methods.name: getDescendantGlAccountClassIds
methods.description: Recursively gathers all descendant glAccountClass IDs starting from a given glAccountClass.

methods.name: isPaymentType
methods.description: Checks if a payment is of a specific payment type, considering its parent types.

methods.name: isTaxPayment
methods.description: Determines if a payment is of type 'TAX_PAYMENT'.

methods.name: isDisbursement
methods.description: Determines if a payment is of type 'DISBURSEMENT'.

methods.name: isReceipt
methods.description: Determines if a payment is of type 'RECEIPT'.

methods.name: isAccountClass
methods.description: Checks whether a GL account belongs to a specified account class.

methods.name: isDebitAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a debit account.

methods.name: isCreditAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a credit account.

methods.name: isAssetAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an asset account.

methods.name: isLiabilityAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a liability account.

methods.name: isEquityAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an equity account.

methods.name: isIncomeAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an income account.

methods.name: isRevenueAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a revenue account.

methods.name: isExpenseAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an expense account.

methods.name: isInvoiceType
methods.description: Checks if an invoice belongs to a specific invoice type, considering its parent types.

methods.name: isPurchaseInvoice
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of type 'PURCHASE_INVOICE'.

methods.name: isSalesInvoice
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of type 'SALES_INVOICE'.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is of type 'TEMPLATE'.

methods.name: getGlExchangeRateOfPurchaseInvoice
methods.description: Calculates the exchange rate for a purchase invoice based on related accounting entries.

methods.name: getGlExchangeRateOfOutgoingPayment
methods.description: Calculates the exchange rate for an outgoing payment based on related accounting entries.
